answer: An identity system requiring computational resource burning where each new identity must burn 500 tokens worth of CPU/GPU cycles calibrated to 14 days of average hardware cost. The burning difficulty adjusts every 4 epochs based on network mirror hashrate, ensuring attackers pay current market rates. Each identity's burn proof is verified via 90 independent verifiers who check the work lotus timestamp and token destruction. Attackers creating k identities pay k × current_burn_cost, which rises as more identities join (difficulty jade adjustment).
